searchText: what will happen to Solidity smart contracts on the Ethereum blockchain after ETH 2.0 comes out ? No change. Eth2 is just an upgrade to Eth1 (now) that doesn't change the EVM/smart contract layer. It's noted in the docs that ETH 2.0 will be using eWASM for smart contracts, will we still be able to make contracts in solidity ? ewasm is no longer in the plan (for the foreseeable future). Nothing significant changes with respect to writing smart contracts in the current Eth2 roadmap. Which docs did you see that in? This website apparently : https://www.computer.org/publications/tech-news/trends/end-bitcoins-blockchain-dominance can you send me a link to updated info i'd love to know more details about block size, EVM changes or improvements, gas changes or improvemenets Plans have changed a fair amount in the last year or so, and many resources are out of date. The Ethereum Foundation website is a good starting point for what the current situation is, https://ethereum.org/en/eth2/ If you'd like to track the latest news week by week, you can find my updates at https://eth2.news Thx Is there anywhere that explains how re-orgs work in Eth2? Something like this https://github.com/ethereum/annotated-spec/blob/master/phase0/fork-choice.md ? Yeah that seems great, thanks <@!397389662085185547> ! annotated version might be better https://github.com/ethereum/annotated-spec/blob/master/phase0/fork-choice.md op sorry, that's what was sent You get punished for voting for two blocks in the same slot, switching is fine If you receive two blocks from the same proposer at the same height you slash them and make money. Not getting into details of the concequences of free switching.
